qogsmall <- read.csv("https://github.com/jnseawright/ps210/raw/refs/heads/main/Data/qogsmall.csv")

head(qogsmall)

summary(qogsmall)

library(tidyverse)

avg_democ <- qogsmall %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(avg_value = mean(democracy, na.rm = TRUE))

library(ggplot2)

ggplot(avg_democ, aes(x = year, y = avg_value)) +
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  labs(title = "Average Level of Democracy Over Time",
       x = "Time",
       y = "Average Democracy") +
  theme_minimal()
  
with(qogsmall,
  t.test(democracy ~ (year>2015)))

with(qogsmall[qogsmall$year>2010,],
  t.test(democracy ~ (year>2015)))
  
democlm.1 <- lm(democracy ~ year + I(year>2015) + year:I(year>2015), data=qogsmall[qogsmall$year>2010,])

democlm.2 <- lm(democracy ~ year, data=qogsmall)
